description: Tumor sample ID.
Normal (reference) sample ID. Null in tumor-only mode; ORANGE uses this null to mark tumor-only mode.
Sampling date. ORANGE writes the run date when no sampling date is given; oncoanalyser gives none.
Experiment type: WHOLE_GENOME or TARGETED.
Primary tumor as Disease Ontology nodes. Empty when no primary tumor is configured; oncoanalyser configures none.
Reference genome version.
Pipeline version string.

LINX results: fusions and breakends.
RNA results from Isofox. Null without RNA data.
LILAC HLA typing.
Immune escape flags computed by ORANGE from the somatic results (rules in the ORANGE README).
Virus Interpreter results.
CHORD homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) prediction.
CUPPA tissue of origin prediction.
PEACH pharmacogenomic genotypes.
SIGS mutational signature allocations.
Paths of the plot images used in the ORANGE PDF.
Disease Ontology ID.
Disease Ontology term.
Purity and ploidy fit with its QC.
Genome-wide tumor characteristics.
Somatic driver catalog entries.
Germline driver catalog entries. Null in tumor-only mode.
Somatic SNVs and indels. A selection, not every call: far fewer entries than purple.somatic.vcf.gz.
Germline SNVs and indels (a selection).
Somatic gene copy number gains and deletions (a selection).
Germline gene amplifications and deletions (a selection).
Chromosome arm copy number gains and losses. The key is spelled "Abberations" in ORANGE.
PURPLE QC.
Fit method: NORMAL, HIGHLY_DIPLOID, SOMATIC or NO_TUMOR.
Purity of tumor in the sample.
Minimum purity with score within 10% of the best fit.
Maximum purity with score within 10% of the best fit.
Average ploidy of the tumor after adjusting for purity.
Minimum ploidy with score within 10% of the best fit.
Maximum ploidy with score within 10% of the best fit.
PURPLE QC status: PASS or one or more WARN and FAIL values.
Germline chromosomal aberrations detected from COBALT ratios (KLINEFELTER, TRISOMY_X, TRISOMY_21, TRISOMY_13, TRISOMY_18, TRISOMY_15, XYY, MOSAIC_X), or NONE.
Mean read depth at AMBER heterozygous sites.
Contamination rate of the tumor sample estimated by AMBER. AMBER estimates it only with a matched normal.
Total number of copy number segments.
Copy number segments with no SV support on either side. A high number indicates poor sample quality.
Number of genes with copy number below 0.5.
True if more than 10 autosomes have major allele copy number above 1.5.
Microsatellite indels per megabase.
Microsatellite status: MSI, MSS or UNKNOWN.
Tumor mutational burden: passing SNVs and indels per megabase.
TMB status: HIGH (above 10 per Mb), LOW or UNKNOWN.
Tumor mutational load: number of missense variants.
TML status: HIGH, LOW or UNKNOWN.
Number of passing structural variants, excluding inferred and single-breakend calls.
Proportion of the genome with loss of heterozygosity (0 to 1 despite the name). Not described in the PURPLE README.
Fusions (a selection).
Somatic breakends in genes (a selection).
Germline breakends in genes (a selection). Null in tumor-only mode.
One entry per HLA allele of the top solution, class I and class II.
Gene group the allele was typed in: MHC_CLASS_1 (HLA-A, -B, -C) or a class II gene such as HLA_DQA1.
Allele ID.
LILAC QC status of the allele's gene group: PASS or one or more warnings.
Allele copy number from the tumor/reference fragment ratio and the PURPLE copy number.
Fragments assigned to the allele in the reference (normal) BAM.
Fragments assigned to the allele in the tumor BAM.

Somatic missense variants matched to the allele.
Somatic nonsense or frameshift variants matched to the allele.
Somatic splice variants matched to the allele.
Somatic synonymous variants matched to the allele.
Somatic inframe indels matched to the allele.
HLA class I loss of function in HLA-A, -B or -C (rules in the ORANGE README).
Inactivation of the antigen presentation pathway (B2M, CALR, TAP1, TAP2, TAPBP, NLRC5, CIITA or RFX5).
Inactivation of the IFN gamma pathway (JAK1, JAK2, IRF2, IFNGR1, IFNGR2, APLNR or STAT1).

CD58 inactivation.
SETDB1 fully amplified.

Percentage of the viral reference sequence covered in the tumor sample.
Mean coverage of the viral genome.
Expected coverage if the virus were clonally integrated once in the tumor DNA.

Probability of HRD.
